annotations.title: imagepeek: add a text watermark to an image

description: imagepeek: Add a text watermark to an image. For PDFs use pdf_watermark. Returns the image with a text watermark (1-200 printable characters, DejaVu Sans Mono) at one of 9 positions, or `tile`d in a staggered grid, with `opacity`, `font_size` (default 5% of the short side), `color`, `angle` and `margin`; text larger than the image is shrunk to fit. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/image-watermark-api.html

angle.description: Text rotation in degrees, clockwise (-180 to 180, default 0).
angle.title: Angle

format.description: Output format (default: the input's; ICO in, PNG out).
format.title: Format

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

margin.description: Pixels from the edge (default half the font size, at least 4); with tile, the gap between marks.
margin.title: Margin

output.description: base64 (default): inline. url: stored for 24 hours; link, metadata.
output.title: Output

position.description: Single mark's place: center, top, bottom, left, right, top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right (default).
position.title: Position

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url
